test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word should fit the context of understanding why it is important. Hence,** "accepting" fits well **with the context of understanding why even academic institutions give leadership assignments.
 
• The other options: **"rejecting," "polishing," and "focusing" do not appropriately fit the context.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Thus, it isn’t hard accepting__ why even in academic institutions throughout the US and worldwide, students are given leadership essay assignments.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rejecting**: means dismissing as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty.
 
• **Polishing**: means making smooth and shiny by rubbing.
 
• **Focusing**: means concentrating on a particular activity or focus.
